Every transaction tells you what happened. DepthReceipt is built around what happened underneath.

Transaction → Execution → Settlement → Receipt → Verification.

DepthReceipt brings the familiar idea of a financial receipt onchain, turning complex activity into a clear, structured and verifiable record.

Don’t just see the transaction. See the depth behind it.
